text: Yes, I do. Five live ideas, in the order I'd build them: (1) Paper-test a wider model-confidence band, to measure it before any real money. (2) Score-event trigger: Novig is about 6.6 s slower than Pinnacle after a score, so buy the stale side only when a score pushes. (3) Cross-exchange arbitrage between Novig and Kalshi, Polymarket or SX, only when both sides pay a profit. (4) Live resting bids just under fair value, pulled the instant a socket moves. (5) Require a second sharp source (SX or Kalshi socket) to agree with Pinnacle before buying. Idea 1's real-money middle tier shipped in v1.0.3 (80-89% sure, 5% edge, 10 cents a bet). Next up are (2) and (5), since they're the safest. Tell me if you want a different order.
